label: wherewhen - Analysis Engine Test
info:
Companion test flow for analysis_engine_flow.json (PLAN.md §2's standing rule — every live flow gets one). Runs entirely against embedded synthetic fixtures, same self-contained approach as medical_history_import_test.json and wherewhen_data_restore_test.json — nothing on the target HA instance needs to exist for this to run.

Checks: (1) the shared parseFluxCsvToRows() CSV parser against a two-identical-header-block fixture — the exact real bug found and fixed this session (a repeated header row across consecutive Flux table blocks was silently misparsed as a data row); (2) every one of the 20 ANALYSES entries has working flux()/shape() functions that don't throw and return valid JSON; (3) a few known-value spot checks (not just "didn't throw") against the synthetic fixture.

Click to test, check the debug panel.

name: Run all checks against embedded fixtures
